Independent exact companion-matrix and rational calculations
correctness.rationale: The zeroth derivative gives the width by I(0)=25w². Dividing by the analytic squared sinc factor then recovers the point-intensity jet at the same order. Its 2k derivative is 2(−1)^k times the unordered gap moment. An independent companion-matrix trace calculation verifies all five moment identities by multiplying the traces of exp(TC) and exp(−TC). The triangular coefficients of e₂, e₄, e₃², e₃e₅ and e₅² are −10, −20, −75, −800 and −3125. They determine the centered polynomial up to simultaneous reversal of the two odd elementary symmetric functions, exactly the reflection ambiguity. When e₃≠0 the first four moments suffice. At e₃=0, a small change of just the constant coefficient keeps the five roots simple, real, and strictly separated, does not change the first four moments, and need not merely reflect the configuration. Exact rational checks confirm the brackets and moments for e₅=1 and 2 and the tenth-derivative difference −375/2. The nonzero-e₃ starting polynomial also has the five stated simple roots; its constant-term perturbation gives sixth-order insufficiency on the open stratum without leaving the strictly separated class. Replay: python /workspace/branches/independent-checks/fourier_jet.py.
residual_risks: Exact Taylor data only; no numerical stability result near e₃=0.

evidence: The closest smaller-component jet theorem addresses four starts only. The full-distance theorems do not recover the distance multiset from five power sums; they also give no eighth-order collision example for five equal-width intervals.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The extra degree-five coefficient and its joint sign invariants with e₃ are material. The audited proof separately determines when those invariants are recoverable and when they can vary invisibly.

evidence: The equal-width full-spectrum fiber theorem equates diffraction to oriented difference measures. Turnpike uses unassigned full distances; the audited equivalent formulation uses only the first five even gap moments after removing the window.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Rephrasing as point homometry does not eliminate the loss of data in the moment truncation. The proposed theorem does not follow from the full-spectrum fiber statement.

Full-intensity reduction is prior and is not credited as a new result.

value.rationale: Full-intensity uniqueness does not specify how many low-frequency exact measurements are needed. This result gives the sharp measurement depth both globally and on a natural open class, isolates the invariant invisible to the shorter jet, and certifies an admissible lower-order collision.
residual_risks: Restricted to five strictly separated equal-width intervals; no claims about noisy data or unequal widths.
